name: Scarlett Emerson
source:
Scarlett Emerson is [url=/c134911/]Grant[/url]'s sister. She is shown to be rude, condescending and hostile, making remarks about the main character's style and commenting on how [url=/c134904/]Kate[/url] supposedly lives on the Sterling's money. If you ask her why she is so mean, she will answer that she is simply realistic and honest. She makes her first appearance in Chapter 1.

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Scarlett_Emerson]Wiki[/url]]
